theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_rv_map_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).map (fun x => c + R • x) = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
